description: Header file defining interfaces and classes for processing downlink PDUs and resource grids in a 5G NR physical layer implementation, including classes for downlink processing, validation, and control.

classes.name: downlink_processor
classes.description: Interface for processing various downlink PDUs and signals within a slot.

classes.name: unique_downlink_processor
classes.description: Manages a downlink processor instance within a scope, ensuring proper finalization.

classes.name: downlink_processor_callback
classes.description: Callback interface extending downlink_processor with a method to finish processing PDUs.

classes.name: downlink_processor_controller
classes.description: Interface for configuring resource grids for downlink processing.

classes.name: downlink_pdu_validator
classes.description: Interface for validating downlink PDUs and configurations.

classes.name: downlink_processor_base
classes.description: Base class providing access to the downlink processor controller and control methods.

classes.name: downlink_processor_pool
classes.description: Interface for managing a pool of downlink processors.

methods.name: process_pdsch
methods.description: Processes a PDSCH PDU with associated transport blocks.

methods.name: finish_processing_pdus
methods.description: Stops accepting PDUs and finalizes processing.

methods.name: configure_resource_grid
methods.description: Configures the resource grid for a slot and returns a unique downlink processor.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Validates various downlink PDUs and configurations.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the downlink processor or pool.

methods.name: get_processor_controller
methods.description: Retrieves the processor controller for a specific slot.
